problem_text:
A logistics firm must dispatch emergency relief packages from distribution hubs C to affected regions D while minimizing total delivery expenses.

The available inventory of packages at each hub (set C) is as follows:  
*C1 has 166 units ready.  
*C2 has 50 units available.  
*C3 holds 117 units in stock.

The required number of packages to be delivered to each region (set D) is specified below:  
*D1 requires 174 units.  
*D2 must receive 115 units.  
*D3 needs 24 units.

The per-unit delivery cost from each hub to each region is provided in the following table:

| From / To | D1 | D2 | D3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | 10 | 17 | 20 |
| C2 | 7  | 5  | 12 |
| C3 | 6  | 18 | 17 |

Determine the shipment quantities to minimize the overall expenditure.
